verdict.rationale: Rainforest's marketing says it ships pre-built embeddable components for reporting, so sellers could plausibly see money data inside the platform. The only evidence is one thin homepage mention. The data-export claim covers the platform owning and exporting its own data, not sellers exporting for their bookkeepers, and the deposits doc only covers changing deposit frequency. Missing for 10: documented per-seller statements, payout/deposit reconciliation reports in the embedded experience, seller-facing exports for month-end close, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, sellers can self-serve their money questions — per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, and exports that let their bookkeeper close the month without contacting me

citations.quote: Reduce development time and get to revenue faster with our pre-built, embeddable components for payments, reporting, chargebacks, merchant onboarding, and more.
